text_block_list.text:
While conducting a routine fit check
of Rice Shower's racing silks—

During the check-up, Rice Shower
seemed somewhat lost in thought.

While worried about Rice Shower,
I was reviewing the training schedule for tomorrow onwards when—

Spotting Rice Shower outside the window, I hurried
out of the Trainer's office and chased after her—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Then, all the roses around her,
and all the people who came to see the garden, everyone..."

Rice Shower is reciting
a picture book all by herself...

That picture book is "The Blue Rose of Happiness,"
her favorite, which she showed me before.

text_block_list.text: I wondered if I even had the right to wear an outfit like that... If I was simply unworthy of it...

text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
That outfit was based on a picture book, right?

text_block_list.text:
"So, I thought if I read the picture book one more time...
maybe the swirls in my head... would clear up..."

text_block_list.text: —Rice... doesn't want... to lose.

text_block_list.text:
Wearing the outfit I made together with you, Big Brother...
I just don't... want to lose...!

I hate it, but the thoughts just keep coming, Rice is...

text_block_list.text:
Put these feelings... into a race...?
Can I really... do something like that...?

How can I get my thoughts across to her...?
Just then, the picture book Rice Shower was holding
caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Y-Yeah...

I borrow the picture book from Rice Shower, flip through
the pages, find the intended passage, and point it out to her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...'Before long, the blue rose wished
to bloom beautifully for everyone's sake.'"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...'As that wish grows stronger,
the blue rose blooms all the more beautifully'..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I see. She turned her feelings...
her emotions... into strength too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother, I... won't lose.
I definitely don't want to lose. I'll run with that feeling in my heart!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, I... will never give up.
I don't want to lose. I'll run with all my heart!

It seems Rice Shower's feelings
have turned a bit more positive...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Because with you, Onii-sama...
we brought... my wish to life...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Because with you, Onee-sama...
we brought... my wish to life...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Because it's filled with everything from my favorite picture book... and all my dreams...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why Rice... wearing these clothes...
doesn't want to lose...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... *sob*...
I don't... *hic*... want that...

text_block_list.text:
And yet... and yet, that's all
I keep thinking about... I hate it... it hurts so much...!

text_block_list.text:
